title: Melon Loader
description: A Forge 1.8.9 mod lets you change backgrounds of minecraft.
body:
# 🍉 Melon Loader
**The ultimate, seamlessly integrated custom background mod for Minecraft 1.8.9.**

Melon Loader completely overhauls the vanilla Minecraft menus, allowing you to easily set your own gorgeous 16:9 wallpapers for the Loading Screen, Main Menu, Multiplayer/Singleplayer, and Settings menus. 

Built with heavy modpacks in mind, Melon Loader is designed to be **100% compatible with Essential, Patcher, and PolishedGUI**, seamlessly replacing their backgrounds without crashing or causing black screen glitches.

### ✨ Key Features

* **Four Custom Background Slots:** Set distinct images for your Forge Loading Screen, Home Page, Play Menus, and Settings Menus.
* **Perfect 16:9 Smart Cropping:** No more stretched or distorted images! Melon Loader uses dynamic UV math to act like a desktop wallpaper—smoothly zooming and cropping your image to perfectly fill the screen, no matter how you resize your window.
* **In-Game Transparency:** When you are actively playing in a world or on a server, Melon Loader gets out of your way. Opening your settings or resource packs in-game will beautifully blur your active gameplay in the background instead of covering it up.
* **Smart Text Overlay:** Menus with lots of text (like Multiplayer or Controls) automatically receive a sleek, 45% dark gradient overlay, ensuring white text remains perfectly readable without ruining the brightness of your Home Page.
* **Native File Explorer:** Powered by **OneConfig**, simply open the mod menu and click "Browse" to open a standard Windows/Mac file explorer. Select any `.png` or `.jpg` right from your computer—no need to type out complicated file paths!

### 🚀 Bulletproof Compatibility
Tired of UI mods breaking your background? Melon Loader uses advanced OpenGL rendering to bypass the hardcoded black boxes from UI mods and PvP Resource Packs (like Bombies). 
* Compatible with **Essential**
* Compatible with **Patcher**
* Compatible with **PolishedGUI**
* Compatible with all **PvP Resource Packs**

### ⚙️ Getting Started

1. Drop `MelonLoader-1.0.jar` into your `mods` folder.
2. Launch Minecraft 1.8.9.
3. Open your **OneConfig** menu (usually `RSHIFT`).
4. Find **Melon Loader** and click the **Browse...** buttons to select your favorite 16:9 wallpapers.
5. Click Save, and your game will instantly update!

**Note on Forge Loading Screens:** For the custom splash screen to work, Forge's default loading UI must be disabled. Melon Loader includes a handy **"Fix Loading Screen"** button right inside the config menu that will automatically configure your `splash.properties` file for you with one click!

### 📥 Requirements
* **Minecraft Forge 1.8.9**
* **OneConfig** (Required for the settings menu)
